hook: The smallest hole-free mirrored lattice room with an unlit point has 12 sides.

readout.label: Fewest sides, hole-free room with one source

summary: Rooms with mirrored walls can hold points that no light ray connects. The authors classify the smallest such rooms built from tilings, finding the 12-sided pinwheel for one source on the isosceles right triangle tiling and 16 sides on the square tiling. They count all smallest rooms for two sources, such as 12 rooms with 24 sides. Many results use exhaustive computer searches within bounds proved by hand, and they cover tiling-based rooms only.
title: Unilluminable rooms: minimal examples, classifications and exceptions
